before.name: Following a five-year war, the Ternateans under Sultan Babullah defeated the Portuguese

changes.name: Ternatean forces under Sultan Babullah take the Portuguese fort after a long siege

updates.review_note: The 16th-century source records Ternatean victory in 1575 after five years of war; the academic Brill chapter describes the siege of the Portuguese fort on Ternate and its surrender in 1575. Wikipedia Fort Kastela identifies the fort as São João Baptista and provides coordinates of its modern ruins, used as a regional reference for the 1575 surrender, not the area of the wider five-year campaign or a precise boundary of the original defenses. The 20 km radius is a gameplay setting. Sources disagree on the day of surrender or departure, so the record remains year-only. A scan of indexed 1575 event titles found no separate named Ternate record; differently worded events or broader ranges can still overlap. The 1570 Hairun assassination row is a distinct precursor and the 1578 Tidore fort a separate development. Existing ID is retained.
